analisis: Suplemento alimenticio en cápsulas a base de aguaje, fenogreco y maca negra, de triple acción. Es un nutracéutico pensado para mujeres que quieren apoyar el volumen de glúteos y piernas y cuidar su figura. Viene en un frasco negro brillante con tapa rosada y una franja rosada en la base; la etiqueta es negra con letras blancas y rosadas. Trae 60 cápsulas y se toman 2 al día con las comidas.
descripcion_visual_en: A small cylindrical supplement bottle with a glossy black body, about twice as tall as it is wide, with rounded shoulders and a wide hot-pink ribbed screw cap printed with small white 'VITALABH' logos. A solid pink band wraps the very bottom of the bottle. Black wraparound label, read from top to bottom: a small white 'VITALABH' logo with a small pink figure icon; a very large bold white word 'AGUAJE'; under it bold white 'COMPLEX' followed by pink '3 EN 1'; a thin pink strip with tiny white text 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; bold italic pink-red 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small rounded pink-outlined boxes joined by white plus signs reading '200 mg AGUAJE', '400 mg FENOGRECO', '200 mg MACA NEGRA'; and a bottom white line '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30 g)'.

identidad_visual.color_palette: Primary: deep glossy black #0D0D0F and hot pink #E8327C. Secondary: soft pink #F58FB8, blush cream #FCE7EF and pure white #FFFFFF. Accents: raspberry red #D81B60 and warm aguaje orange #F2A33A (only in the fruit and warm light).
identidad_visual.visual_style: Modern, feminine and bold beauty-wellness advertising: high contrast black and pink, clean premium product photography, confident and fresh, Latin American e-commerce energy without looking cheap.
identidad_visual.visual_atmosphere: Confident, vibrant, feminine and warm; glossy highlights, soft pink glows, a feeling of self-care and self-assurance.
identidad_visual.graphic_language: Rounded pill shapes and rounded cards, soft pink gradients, brush-stroke or solid pink bands behind key words, thin line icons, soft drop shadows, natural ingredient props (aguaje fruit with reddish scaly skin and orange pulp, fenugreek seeds, black maca root), strong contrast between black, pink and white.
identidad_visual.text_typography: Poppins Bold for headlines and Poppins Regular for the rest of the text.
identidad_visual.art_direction: Every ad keeps the black-and-pink identity of the bottle: the product always sharp, glossy and true to the photo; headlines thick, white or pink with maximum contrast; backgrounds never plain white; ingredients and people look real, warm and natural. Visible claims stay moderate and truthful.

beneficios: Apoya el volumen de glúteos y piernas
Tres ingredientes en un solo frasco
Fácil de tomar: 2 cápsulas al día
caracteristicas: Aguaje 200 mg, fenogreco 400 mg y maca negra 200 mg por porción
Con vitamina A y vitamina E
Se toma con las comidas principales
